issue.title: Codex web__run searches and page opens inside code-mode exec never reach tool_calls.jsonl

task_type_fields.impact:
Codex web research is invisible to SASE telemetry, so tool-usage analysis is wrong: research.37.cld
concluded from tool_calls.jsonl that codex researchers "cannot search the web" (0 of 105 runs),
which is false. Any research-swarm quality/cost measurement (contribution ledgers, eval sets,
per-researcher web-usage stats) and the Agents-tab tool-call views undercount codex. Grok and
muse already map their `web_search` tools to WebSearch; codex is the odd one out (agy has its own
gap, sase-15o).
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/llm_provider/_tool_call_codex.py (_normalize_codex_tool_call_event handles command_execution/file_change/function_call/named tools; nothing maps codex web__run calls nested in the code-mode exec custom tool)
task_type_fields.repro:
1. Find a codex researcher run that cited web sources, e.g. research.37.cdx
   (`~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/202610/01/20261001130220/`).
2. Its `tool_calls.jsonl` holds 114 `Bash` records and no WebSearch/WebFetch records.
3. Its codex rollout log (`~/.codex/sessions/2026/10/01/rollout-2026-10-01T13-03-34-*.jsonl`)
   shows `custom_tool_call` items named `exec` whose code-mode input calls
   `tools.web__run({search_query: [...]})` and `tools.web__run({open: [{ref_id: "https://..."}]})`,
   and the outputs contain fetched page text (anthropic.com, arxiv.org, nature.com, aclanthology.org).
4. Across 2026-09/10 codex rollout logs, 15 of 35 identifiable cdx-researcher sessions (70 of 1,512
   sessions overall) used `web__run`; none of it reaches SASE's tool-call telemetry.

issue.creation_reason: Found while consolidating #research_swarm research: telemetry showed zero codex web calls, which led a researcher to wrongly conclude codex cannot search the web, and it blocks any measurement of researcher tool use.

payload.description: Sibling telemetry gap: agy tool-call extraction is off, so gem research is equally invisible
